facts.value: The Study Service Point and the hotline are your central contact points for questions regarding studies, applications, and student administration.
The central study counseling supports you competently with all concerns related to studying.
The PBS offers you support and a listening ear for personal concerns.
The PBS provides online lectures and workshops every semester on topics such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management.
The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges, such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blockages.
In addition to a variety of sports offerings, the university sports department also provides courses and videos for stress management and self-assertion.
The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) in starting their careers.
Strengthen your career skills through workshops, coaching, and networks.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and critical environment against discrimination and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Ombudspersons are your contact persons for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding studies and promotion.
The Scholarship Service supports students and staff across all departments.
The Student Union offers affordable housing near the campus.
The Student Union informs and advises about all possibilities of study financing, such as BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans.
